description: This file contains the PHP class 'Special' which extends the base Controller class for OpenCart. It defines the 'index' method responsible for generating and returning a view of special products, applying filters, image resizing, pricing, and tax calculations, and assembling product data for display.

classes.name: Special
classes.description: Controller class for the 'special products' module in OpenCart, responsible for fetching and displaying special offers.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that loads language, filters special products based on settings, processes images, prices, and tax, then returns a rendered view of the special products module.

search-terms: Opencart catalog controller extension module special
